title: Art movements timeline
examples: What is the biggest difference between Renaissance and Baroque art?
Can you show us how Impressionism changed painting?

explain.say: Today we will look at art movements over time.

items: Baroque: Drama and emotion in art

explain.say: The Renaissance saw a focus on human potential and classical balance.
Next, the Baroque period used intense drama and strong emotion in art.
Impressionism focused on capturing the changing effects of light outdoors.
Real-life example: Think about a photograph taken near the sea.
A common mistake is confusing the focus of movements.

faq.q: How do I know which movement an artwork belongs to?
faq.a: Look closely at the subject matter and the brushwork used. Does it look very balanced or very dramatic?
asks: What is the main focus of the art?
How can I date a painting by style?

faq.q: Was the shift from academic art to modern art sudden?
faq.a: No, it was a gradual process involving many artists challenging established rules over time.
asks: Did artists just start doing new things?

faq.q: What is the difference between Realism and Impressionism?
faq.a: Realism aims to depict life exactly as it is seen, while Impressionism focuses on the fleeting visual effect of light.
asks: Are they both about everyday life?
Which one is more about light?

faq.q: Do all art movements have a political reason?
faq.a: Not always, but many movements did reflect the social or political changes happening in their time.

faq.q: What does 'Humanism' mean in Renaissance art?
faq.a: It means that human beings and their potential were seen as the most important subject in art and thought.
asks: What is the focus of the Renaissance?
What is the idea behind Humanism?

facts: The Renaissance period saw a renewed interest in classical Greek and Roman ideals.
Baroque art is often characterized by intense emotion and dramatic use of light and shadow.
Impressionists often painted scenes outdoors, which was a new practice.
Modern art covers a very wide range of styles and ideas over time.

quiz.say: An artwork that uses strong diagonals and deep shadows to create drama is most likely from which period?
quiz.why: The Baroque period is famous for its intense drama and dramatic use of light and shadow.

wrong.1: Renaissance art usually favors calm balance over drama.
wrong.2: Impressionism focuses on light, not deep, dramatic shadows.
wrong.3: Neoclassicism prefers clear, orderly lines over high drama.

quiz.say: If an artist is painting a landscape focusing only on how the sunlight looks at one specific moment, they are most likely using the style of:
quiz.why: Impressionism's main goal was capturing the fleeting visual effect of light.

wrong.0: Realism tries to capture the scene exactly, not just the light effect.
wrong.1: Baroque art is usually focused on figures and strong emotion.
wrong.2: Renaissance art tends to be more structured and balanced.

quiz.say: A painting celebrating human achievement and classical ideals, like David's work, suggests which movement?
quiz.why: Neoclassicism was a return to the order and ideals of classical antiquity.

wrong.0: Impressionism is too focused on light to be about grand ideals.
wrong.1: Baroque drama is more intense than the measured ideals of Neoclassicism.
wrong.3: Romanticism prioritizes wild emotion over classical order.
